messages.content: Write executable code, in one ordinary fenced code block. You are the main programmer. Implement every decision actually given in the public request and exact owner replies. Source wording overrides preliminary notes and the previous implementation. Compare early returns and overlapping rules. Preserve confirmed behavior wherever it applies. When different policies consistent with the sources would produce different outputs for an input, explicitly leave just that case undecided. Do not invent a default, a threshold or a priority. For a function scope return exactly one definition with the same name and arguments. Place any needed imports inside the definition. Use native indentation. On an operative Python line you may cite source IDs as a trailing comment of the form # [P1, H1] using only the actual IDs present. Produce short code. Omit explanations, docstrings and tests.
